# Seed registry for the `us-apply-relocated-registry` BDD fixture.
#
# Note where this file lives: `docs/specs/requirements.yaml`. There is
# deliberately NO `docs/scenarios.yaml` anywhere in this fixture — the
# only thing that can lead the engine here is
# `documents.scenarios_yaml` in the fixture's own `true-bdd.yaml`.
#
# Engineered so `us apply 95.2 --fix` walks its single AC through the
# SHIPPED us-apply checklist and exercises the add-entry branch:
#
#   - "present?" FAILS: nothing here references story
#     docs/product/stories/95.2-relocated-registry.yaml. The F: adds a
#     scenario for lineage 95.2-001 to the scratch registry.
#   - "duplicate?" PASSES: the fix added exactly one entry.
#
# The re-walk then finds both prompts clean, the walk converges, and the
# scratch copy is renamed over THIS file — which is the assertion the
# fixture exists for. A hardcoded ./docs/scenarios.yaml re-entering the
# engine cannot seed a scratch copy from here, so the run would die
# before the first AI turn.
#
# E2E-960 is unrelated on purpose: it anchors the "leave every other
# entry alone" assertion.

metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-08-13"
  description: "Relocated-registry seed for us-apply-relocated-registry fixture"

scenarios:
  E2E-960:
    description: "Unrelated scenario that must remain untouched"
    service: "web-service"
    last_updated: "2026-08-13"
    user_stories:
      - story: "docs/product/stories/90.2-unrelated.yaml"
        scenario_id: "90.2-001"
        merge_date: "2026-08-13"
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - "the web app is running"
      when:
        - "the Claude User opens the settings page"
      then:
        - "the settings page renders the account section"

  E2E-961:
    description: "The MCP server returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body reporting the service as healthy for a GET request to /health"
    service: ""
    last_updated: "2026-08-17"
    user_stories:
      - story: "docs/product/stories/95.2-relocated-registry.yaml"
        scenario_id: "95.2-001"
        merge_date: "2026-08-17"
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - "the MCP server is running on its configured port"
        - "the server exposes a health endpoint at /health"
      when:
        - "the Claude User sends a GET request to /health"
      then:
        - "the server returns HTTP 200"
        - "and the response body reports the service status as healthy"
